description: Alertes trafic en temps réel sur les lignes du réseau STAR is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des alertes trafic en temps réel sur les lignes de bus et métro du réseau STAR. Ce jeu de données est amené à s'enrichir dans le courant de l'année 2016 afin de vous offrir la contextualisation des informations par arrêt en plus des lignes. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are bus, star, trafic, alerte, perturbation, problème. The portal shows 107 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2016-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
